verdicts.explanation: The abstract and conclusions give ~5.92×10-6 S cm-1 at 40 °C for PEO-PVP+NaPF6 (O/Na+ = 8, sample SPE 5), which is the paper's own experimental result. Temperature, method (impedance spectroscopy), and solution casting are stated, and the activation energy is correctly left null because the paper gives only a range for all samples.
The abstract and Table 4 give 2.46×10-4 S cm-1 at 100 °C for SPE 5 (O/Na+ = 8), measured in this work. The temperature and origin are correct and the secondary fields are consistent with the paper.
